rows.note: Use this colloquial expression for the everyday activity of gambling or betting money.

example.english: I usually stay away from gambling because I’m afraid of losing money.
example.traditional: 我平時唔賭錢，驚輸咗啲錢攞唔返。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ping4 si4 m4 dou2 cin2 geng1 syu1 zo2 di1 cin4 lo2 m4 faan2

rows.note: Use this as the more formal or general noun for gambling, especially in writing or official contexts.

example.english: The government has stepped up its crackdown on online gambling.
example.traditional: 政府加強打擊網上賭博。
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 gaa1 koeng4 daa2 gik1 mong5 soeng6 dou2 bok3
